turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I stopped the estradiol and injections yesterday as the clinic instructed.

turns.speaker: Dr Orin Lark
turns.text: That matches the planned stop at ten weeks. Keep taking the prenatal vitamin.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: How did you calculate the due date?

turns.speaker: Dr Orin Lark
turns.text: A day-five embryo was transferred on November 15. That gives August 3 as the estimated due date.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I would like the blood screening after we discuss what it can and cannot tell us.
